title: Information Divergence and Endogenous Evolution of Asymmetric Information
abstract: arXiv:2610.11200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard theories trace information asymmetry to privately held information, heterogeneous signals, or costly information acquisition. We identify a distinct mechanism: otherwise identical rational agents observing a common Markov state at asynchronous times can hold different predictive distributions because their information differs in age. When the transition kernel separates information ages, independent Bernoulli observation arrivals make such divergence recur infinitely often almost surely, even with identical arrival probabilities. When agents instead choose costly updating intensities, independent update realizations can regenerate heterogeneous information ages among ex ante identical agents. translated_title: 信息分歧与非对称信息的内生演化
translated_abstract: 标准理论将信息不对称归因于私人持有的信息、异质性的信号或需要成本的信息获取。我们识别出一种不同的机制：在其他方面完全相同的理性主体，即使观察同一个马尔可夫状态，但如果观察的时间不同步，也会因为其信息的新旧程度（信息年龄）不同而持有不同的预测分布。当转移核能够区分信息年龄时，即使观测到达概率相同，独立的伯努利观测到达也会使这种信息分歧几乎必然地无限次重现。当主体选择需要付出成本的更新强度时，独立的更新实现也能够在事前完全相同的主体之间重新产生异质的信息年龄。在平稳的高斯AR(1)环境中，其后果既取决于共同的信息陈旧程度，也取决于信息年龄差距：在保持年龄差距不变的情况下，更陈旧的信息会提高个体的不确定性，同时降低预期平方预测分歧，并…
tldr: 本文提出信息不对称的一种新机制——信息年龄差异：即使理性主体观察同一马尔可夫状态，只要观测时间不同步，其信息新旧程度不同就会导致预测分布的分歧，且这种分歧在相当一般的条件下几乎必然无限次重现。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a novel mechanism of information asymmetry based on information age: otherwise identical rational agents observing a common Markov state at asynchronous times develop divergent predictive distributions, and this divergence recurs infinitely often almost surely, even regenerating endogenously when agents choose costly updating intensities.
